title: Asahina Mafuyu — Nightcord at 25:00〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's what, the third time we're meeting here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's becoming our regular haunt!
I'm glad I suggested it♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At first, I thought it was really unnecessary to have a hangout at the diner just because we released a song.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Isn't that hard on you, Kanade?
You don't really like going out, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wouldn't like to meet up in person all the time, but if it's only every now and then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew, I was worried you hated it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm okay with this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sweet! Let's start our celebratory party when the food gets here! You need to eat something proper, Kanade, you can't live off instant noodles!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My housekeeper cooked dinner for me yesterday. I eat normal food too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your HOUSEKEEPER?! You hired a housekeeper?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. It frees up time for me to work on music, and I get healthy homemade meals cooked for me. She cooks for me twice a week and cleans.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha, making music really is your life, huh.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think your housekeeper may be a girl from my school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What? Ms. Mochizuki's from the same school as you? How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A girl from my club that I talk to often told me her friend works as domestic help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, what? You talk to people at school?
What's she like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know how to describe her... Her name's Shizuku Hinomori, and she's a famous idol, but I don't really know about the things she does outside school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hold on a sec!
Shizuku Hinomori who used to be the front girl of Cheerful * Days?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, she quit that group, no?
I had no idea she was in the same school as Mafuyu. Nice!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's really beautiful, isn't she? Unlike Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? She may have a more memorable face, but my overall silhouette is—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena's always pushing her little bust up for photos, trying to make it look bigger.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Where's this coming from? I don't do that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can you two calm down?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You interrupted me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, wow...
So this is what Mafuyu's like when she's angry...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The pressure is overwhelming...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I didn't say that in anger.
But...maybe I was angry?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You might have helped me make a new discovery. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line: (Her eyes aren't smiling at all!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So we were talking about why you think my housekeeper's from your school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. It's an unusual occupation for a high school student, so I immediately thought it might be her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That'd be a remarkable coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of coincidences!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My classmate An formed a group with two boys from our school and a girl from Miyamasuzaka. They sing together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I swear she mentioned one of the members is called Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Could it be your younger brother, Ena?
Didn't he tell you about it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nah. We don't talk about stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What, you don't even care to know about your brother's hobbies? Poor Akito has such an unsympathetic sister.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm just not interested in his music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The world's so small, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We met online but it turned out we all live in the same city, and here we are gathered around a table, having a meal at a local diner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is that something you're happy about or not?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't think I'm disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it's great to be able to meet up and have a meal together!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wooo, my fries arrived!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You always order fries when we come here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Because I looove fries♪
You're welcome to them, too! I'll eat them when they're not so hot.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're still so sensitive to hot food, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks for sharing, but better hurry up and have some before they're all gone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nooo! When you say that, I can't tell if you're joking!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks for the fries.
